newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices fall on sluggish export demand.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices fall on sluggish export demand.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell by nine rupees to 1,102 rupees per quintal on Thursday on sustained speculative selling and sluggish export demand, dealers said.
They said new crop arrivals of castorseed were yet to pick up but sustained old crop supplies has suprised the trade.
Groundnut oil was steady at the reduced level of 405/406 rupees per 10 kg on renewed physical support at the lower level ahead of festivals. In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 550 rupees per 15 kg.
